negative_findings.description: No Reuters or Bloomberg dedicated stream for Czech bank technology/vendor contracts was found. Searches for Reuters coverage of Komerční banka technology contracts returned only stock-data aggregators (MarketBeat, TradingView, SimplyWallSt) and Wikipedia, not wire reporting.
negative_findings.result_summary: Global wires cover CZ banks mainly for earnings, M&A and macro, not vendor selections; treat Reuters/Bloomberg as low-yield for this cell's topics.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids spending collection budget on expensive wire monitoring that will not produce vendor/partnership signal; the vendor newswires and trade press carry that instead.

negative_findings.description: No Celent, Forrester or Gartner report specifically sizing Czech banking/payments vendor market share was located. Celent's European e-commerce payments modelling covers DE, NL, PL, ES and UK — Czechia is explicitly not in that set.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-specific analyst market-share data appears not to exist as a standalone product; CZ appears only inside CEE/Europe aggregates or in award write-ups (e.g. MONETA Money Bank Model Bank 2022).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed analysts aggregate CZ league tables; in practice CZ must be inferred from CEE-level products, IBSi deal counts, or non-analyst market reports of lower credibility.

negative_findings.description: The Czech-language seed query about foreign media reporting Czech bank technology contracts ('zahraniční média česká banka technologická smlouva oznámení dodavatel') returned only ČNB regulatory opinions and ČNB e-ZAK procurement documents — no meta-coverage of foreign reporting.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-language phrasing does not index international coverage of CZ bank deals; the productive cs-language route is querying Czech bank/vendor proper names, which surfaces English vendor wire releases (e.g. nCino/ČSOB on GlobeNewswire).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Documents a method correction: for this English-language cell, local-language value comes from local entity names and aliases, not from local phrasing about foreign media.

negative_findings.description: Several high-value sources in this cell (bne IntelliNews, Euromoney, American Banker/PaymentsSource, Celent, Gartner/Forrester, GlobalData) are metered or subscription-only; full-text confirmation of deal details was not possible from search results alone.
negative_findings.result_summary: Headlines and abstracts are retrievable; deal specifics often are not without a licence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget or licence decisions are needed before these sources can be relied on for evidence rather than signal detection.

coverage_gaps.description: No systematic vendor-newsroom watchlist exists yet, although vendor sites (Temenos, nCino, IDEMIA, FICO, Finshape, Antelop, Global Payments) proved to be the earliest and most detailed disclosure point for CZ bank deals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an explicit watchlist of 25-40 banking/payments vendor newsrooms and case-study libraries active in CEE and diff their indexes on a schedule for Czech client names and their diacritic-free variants.

coverage_gaps.description: English sources render Czech bank names inconsistently — 'Ceska sporitelna' vs 'Česká spořitelna', 'Komercni banka' vs 'Komerční banka', 'Ceskoslovenska obchodni banka' vs 'ČSOB', plus one observed misspelling 'Czechzia' in a headline. Naive keyword matching will miss items.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Maintain an alias/transliteration table (with and without diacritics, acronyms, parent-group names: Erste, KBC, SocGen, RBI, UniCredit) and query every variant; add fuzzy matching for headline typos.

coverage_gaps.description: Seznam-independent CEE English outlets beyond bne IntelliNews (e.g. Emerging Europe, CEE fintech newsletters, Finovate regional coverage) were only lightly sampled; their CZ-specific yield is unassessed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass over emerging-europe.com, Finovate, Fintech Baltic/CEE newsletters and Czech-adjacent English startup media to measure CZ banking-payments article volume before committing them to the monitoring set.

coverage_gaps.description: No credible aggregate view of CZ banking/payments vendor market shares was identified; only vendor-count proxies (IBSi Sales League Table) and generic market-size reports of unverified quality (e.g. marketdataforecast.com).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat CZ vendor share as something to be reconstructed bottom-up from individual deal records collected in this cell, rather than sourced; assess IBSi and GlobalData licences as the only aggregate options.

coverage_gaps.description: All URLs here are search-result-derived and unverified for liveness; several sites (Euromoney, American Banker, Celent) are bot-defended and may return 403 to automated fetches without being dead.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass with a browser-like fetcher and treat 403/timeout as bot-defence rather than death; re-check 404s for moved URLs before retiring a source.

brief: English-language international coverage of CZ banking-payments deals is real but thinly distributed: no single outlet covers Czechia systematically, so the cell works as a lattice of vendor press wires (GlobeNewswire, Business Wire), specialist trade press with country archives (IBS Intelligence Czech Republic tag, FinTech Futures Czechia, The Paypers, Finextra), and parent-group English press rooms (Erste, KBC, RBI, SocGen/UniCredit) that disclose CZ subsidiary technology moves before or instead of local PR. The highest-value and earliest disclosures are vendor-side — the Komerční banka/Temenos selection and go-live, ČSOB's nCino platform choice, ING's FICO risk selection — which argues for a vendor-newsroom watchlist as the backbone rather than a media watchlist. Analyst aggregation is weaker than the cell rationale assumed: no Czech-specific Celent/Forrester/Gartner market-share product was found, and CZ appears only inside CEE aggregates, IBSi deal counts, or award write-ups such as MONETA Money Bank's Celent Model Bank award. Practical recall depends on an alias table for diacritic and transliteration variants of Czech bank names, since English headlines render them inconsistently.
